question_bank_hash_scope: Sanitized used-fields projection; original frozen private file retained unchanged in audit.

arms.A0: One original Russian query, public default K=3.
arms.A1: One string: exact RU original + space + exact DE equivalent.
arms.A2: Two separate calls: exact RU original, exact DE equivalent; union and RRF60, deduplicate native IDs.
arms.A3: Two Russian calls: exact RU original, exact ru_control_1; union and RRF60.
arms.A4: Adaptive first: exact RU original; read returned evidence before static arms; stop if all requested facets explicitly supported, else one new focused query for missing evidence, no guessed answer inserted.

order: A4 before other arms within each family to prevent cross-arm leakage; static arms cyclically rotated by family. Order is a latency confound.

originals: SHA identity confirmed for actual Gause/Gubin/Markin evidence. Does not establish full import; no independent German original gold.
observed_state: One consistent data/projection state in core; no source/revision binding conflicts. Native state and runtime receipts retained privately.
reader_method: Fresh isolated readers for Q/F/C; own packets only. A4 answers recorded during original adaptive execution.
gold_isolation: Original-based gold prepared by independent participant. Live operator did not read original gold; evidence judge saw unique packets without arm/rank labels.
F05_sensitivity: Strict frozen gold retained; separate task-essential sensitivity because river name was not necessary to asked method of connection.
fusion: Offline RRF60, source/revision/state validated; not executed backend reranker or model answer.
background: Concurrent operator sampler; no accepted-state change observed in core; isolated/cold-cache conditions not established.
restart: Later planned restart began after final live cutoff; its calls and operator availability statistics excluded.
primary_result_contract: Existing seven-key schema; 26 private actual-answer rows; Hit@5/10 and product E2E are null.
privacy: Public allowlist aggregates only. Raw text, native IDs, original gold, reader packets and runtime receipts retained in separate private audit; full PDFs excluded.
limitations: 8 purposive early RU-source families from one book; not random or corpus-representative.
A4 always first, static arms cyclically rotated; latency order confound.
Single judge and single Q/F/C reader run per condition.
Core source eligibility limited to original-matched observed passages; whole-corpus coverage unknown.
Post-core context/source-filter diagnostics cannot improve frozen main-arm scores.
German diagnostics have no independent original gold.
No end-to-end client clocks, model stages, SQL plans, large-corpus recall or resource acceptance.
